title: Northstar backup policy
excerpt: The database operations lead approves production restores. Restore into an isolated database first and validate the requested records before touching production.

title: Northstar backup policy
excerpt: The recovery point objective is 15 minutes. The recovery time objective is four hours. Full daily backups are retained for 30 days and monthly backups for 12 months.

title: Northstar incident response
excerpt: For a SEV-1 incident, the on-call engineer immediately pages the incident commander and opens an incident channel. The communications lead posts a customer status update within 15 minutes.

title: Northstar access policy
excerpt: Managers approve the business need for application access. Application owners approve the role. Temporary elevated privileges expire after eight hours.
